bug_summary: toJsonSchemaで定義キーに`/`や`~`が含まれる場合、JSON Pointerのエスケープ (~0, ~1) をせずに$refを生成していたため不正な$refになる
pr_description: `getDefinitionRef` wrapped a single string template in its own helper function, used at just two call sites in `convertSchema`. This inlines the `#/$defs/${referenceId}` template directly at both places and removes the helper, cutting down on indirection for such a small piece of logic.
